# Generated Cmake Pico project file

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Initialise pico_sdk from installed location
# (note this can come from environment, CMake cache etc)

# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.1.1)
set(toolchainVersion 14_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.1.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
set(PICO_SDK_PATH "C:/Users/kedem/.pico-sdk/sdk/2.1.1")
set(PICO_SDK_TINYUSB_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/lib/tinyusb")

if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD pico2 CACHE STRING "Board type")

# Pull in Raspberry Pi Pico SDK (must be before project)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(Get_PS4 C CXX ASM)

# Initialise the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# Add executable. Default name is the project name, version 0.1

set(TINYUSB_HOST 1)

add_executable(Get_PS4 Get_PS4.cpp hid_app.c E220.cpp send_data.cpp)

pico_set_program_name(Get_PS4 "Get_PS4")
pico_set_program_version(Get_PS4 "0.1")

set(FAMILY rp2040)
#define CFG_TUSB_MCU OPT_MCU_RP2040

# Modify the below lines to enable/disable output over UART/USB
pico_enable_stdio_uart(Get_PS4 1)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(Get_PS4 0)

add_subdirectory(lib/Pico-PIO-USB)
# add_subdirectory(lib/tinyusb)

target_sources(Get_PS4 PRIVATE
    ${PICO_TINYUSB_PATH}/src/portable/raspberrypi/pio_usb/hcd_pio_usb.c
)

add_compile_definitions(
    CFG_TUSB_MCU=OPT_MCU_RP2040
    CFG_TUSB_RHPORT0_MODE=OPT_MODE_HOST
    CFG_TUH_ENABLED=1
)


add_library(pio_usb_host INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(pio_usb_host INTERFACE pico_pio_usb)

# Add the standard library to the build
target_link_libraries(Get_PS4
pico_stdlib
pio_usb_host
hardware_uart
tinyusb_board
tinyusb_host
)

# Add the standard include files to the build
target_include_directories(Get_PS4 PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
        lib/Pico-PIO-USB
        # lib/tinyusb
        # lib/tinyusb/src
        # lib/tinyusb/hw
)

pico_add_extra_outputs(Get_PS4)
